HOME SCIENCE MARCH — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids

   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)
